name: WHAT HAPPENS NOW?
source:
Visual novel set in a distant future where mankind realizes its existence matters.

While time keeps marching on, two souls wander alone and consider if they should, or should not, take part in an experiment to improve humanity's life...

[From [url=https://br0kenleg.itch.io/whathappensnow]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
视觉小说以遥远的未来为背景，人类意识到自己的存在很重要。

时间不断流逝，两个灵魂独自徘徊，思考是否应该参加一项改善人类生活的实验……

[来自[url=https://br0kenleg.itch.io/whathappensnow]itch.io[/url]]
